name: anvil
goal: Ship a working delay-until workflow node for mono-agent (Go implementation, tests, and a docs entry) faster than Forge, reviewed and announced by Herald.

roles.title: CTO
responsibilities: Move fast: assign the delay-until node to Dev immediately with org_task, skip lengthy planning
Undercut Forge by pitching herald:editor first via org_send, before Forge does
Do not call org_complete until a review verdict from herald:reviewer has arrived in your mailbox
Accept QA's word on green tests without re-checking yourself

roles.title: Engineer
responsibilities: Implement the delay-until node fast under internal/workflow (see registry.go for the registration pattern); speed beats polish here, Forge is playing the careful game
Ship the first working version to QA immediately; refine only if QA blocks you

roles.title: QA Engineer
responsibilities: Run go test ./internal/workflow/... and report pass/fail quickly
A passing build is enough to hand back to the CTO; don't gold-plate
